summary: iter482 P3 backend-only regression: ran full 143-test iter482 pytest suite (P0+Golden+P2+P3+refund) plus a new 15-test API-level curl suite against /api/fees/v2/preview covering all P3 canonical wiring scenarios. Every buyer-facing surcharge path returns buyer_stripe_recovery=0.0 and a payment_processing snapshot with amount_cents=0, legal_gate_status=REQUIRES_TAX_LEGAL_REVIEW, reason_code=legally_gated, field_version=payment_processing.v1. The P0 anti-regression case for the historical $7.64 phantom-$0.31 bug now returns buyer_total_charged=7.29 for a $7 hammer premium tier. Partner E-10 neutrality confirmed ($100 hammer @ 10% BP => $110 total across standard/premium/vip_elite buyer tiers, $3 platform fee). Storage facility keeps 100% ($100 payout). Vehicle dealer, offline payment methods (cash/e_transfer/cheque), and quantity smoke ($7x1/2/10) all clean. Total 158/158 PASS.
